headline: STREET FIGHTER TRAILER FEATURES UNRELEASED TUPAC RECORDING
body: The new Street Fighter trailer pairs its arcade-world action with an unreleased Tupac recording created for Mike Tyson in the 1990s. Paramount says the movie is set in 1993 and follows Ryu and Ken as Chun-Li recruits them for the World Warrior Tournament. 50 Cent plays Balrog, alongside Jason Momoa as Blanka, Noah Centineo as Ken, Andrew Koji as Ryu and Callina Liang as Chun-Li. The movie is scheduled to reach theaters October 16, 2026.
